basic_info.description: This Mediterranean home on a quiet and lovely street boasts incredible curb appeal. For those that appreciate traditional architecture, this residence has a thoughtful layout and is fully detached. As you enter the formal hall you will cherish the period details that continue throughout the home. The living room has a cathedral ceiling, fireplace with an ornate mantle and parquet wood floors. The dining room with an impressive balcony, natural wood trim and plaster crown molding is both elegant and inviting. The updated kitchen has natural wood cabinets, quartz counters and stainless appliances including 5-burner stove and double oven. Completing the main level are two bedrooms overlooking the yard, a rear balcony, a full bath with a shower, a tub and original art deco finishes. The lower level has a family room with a custom bar area and a full bathroom. Featuring a 2-car garage with storage and laundry and a low maintenance rear yard. Don't delay in seeing this well kept home.
